info.name: Library Reservation and Issue API
info.description:
Walks the library workflow: catalogue search, reservation limits and duplicates, issuing, returns and fines, cancelling, copy counts, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8116). Repeatable: it registers fresh members and adds a uniquely titled book with a random ISBN each run.

exec: const digits = (n) => Array.from({ length: n }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)).join("");

item.name: Register a fresh member for this run
Add a book with one copy (valid 13-digit ISBN)

exec: pm.test("One copy, all available", () => { pm.expect(b.totalCopies).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.availableCopies).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.isbn).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("isbn")); });

item.name: The same ISBN again is rejected

exec: pm.test("Found with its single copy", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].availableCopies).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].myLoanStatus).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Reserving the same book twice is a conflict
The only copy is gone for member B
The member sees their own reservation in search

exec: pm.test("Marked as mine", () => { const b = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(b.myLoanStatus).to.eql("RESERVED"); pm.expect(b.availableCopies).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 4. Librarian issues and takes it back
The reservation waits at the desk

exec: pm.test("One, with the member's name", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].memberName).to.eql("Postman Member"); });

item.name: A reserved book cannot be returned yet

exec: pm.test("Issued with a due date two weeks away", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("ISSUED"); pm.expect(l.dueDate).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(l.overdue).to.be.false; pm.expect(l.issuedBy).to.eql("librarian"); });

item.name: A member cannot cancel an issued book
The member sees the book on loan
Reserving an issued book is still a conflict

exec: pm.test("Returned on time, no fine", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("RETURNED"); pm.expect(l.fine).to.eql(0); });

item.name: The copy is back on the shelf
Member A cannot cancel B's reservation
A cancelled reservation cannot be issued
Member A may borrow it again after returning

exec: pm.test("Two available while one is reserved", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().availableCopies).to.eql(2));

item.name: Member B reserves a second copy
Copies cannot drop below those in use
Loan list can be filtered by member
Member cannot see the librarian's loans
